title: Restore expired default product drafts and add one-click reset to recreate the three products

requirements.text: Add a user-visible action in the Product Editor workspace to recreate the three default products (Digital Planner Mastery, Canva Templates Empire, Printable Wall Art Studio) by resetting local drafts back to the shipped defaults.

quotes: You suggested and created those products for me yesterday... I did not publish the draft so they expired. Can you create them again?

acceptanceCriteria: ProductsWorkspace shows a clearly labeled control (e.g., "Restore default products")
Clicking the control removes any saved local drafts (using the existing localDrafts reset capability) and immediately repopulates the editor with the three DEFAULT_PRODUCTS entries
After reset, the visible product names match exactly: "Digital Planner Mastery", "Canva Templates Empire", and "Printable Wall Art Studio"

requirements.text: Add a confirmation step before resetting drafts to defaults so users do not accidentally wipe their local edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to restore defaults prompts the user to confirm the destructive action
Confirm performs the reset and switches the workspace to the first product tab (product-1)

requirements.text: Ensure PDF/ZIP generation after restoring defaults uses the restored in-memory product data (not undefined/empty data), and if generation fails, show an error message that is specific and actionable in English.
acceptanceCriteria: After restoring defaults, generating a single product produces a bundle without requiring any backend product data
If PDF generation throws, the UI error includes the product number and indicates the user should verify required fields (name, subtitle, description) are present (English-only)
If ZIP generation throws, the UI error indicates ZIP creation failed and to retry (English-only)

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add new product themes beyond the three existing defaults.
Do not implement third-party authentication or external database storage.
